stewardshipDecisions.kimiReviewSummary: Kimi review accepted: INFORMS is safe for knowledge-to-design edges when caveated as non-numerical. AFFECTS is safe for causal/performance impact when CONSTRAINS would overclaim. SUPPORTS is safe for physical support when directionality is clear and TRANSFERS_LOAD_TO is not more precise. RESISTS is safe for structural-system-to-load edges when no capacity claim is made. COLLECTS and CONVEYS are safe for drainage flow edges. DRAINS_TO is safe for gravity drainage connections. MITIGATES is safe when caveated as risk reduction not full prevention. COORDINATES_WITH and TRANSFERS_LOAD_TO continue to be safe. All candidates use existing nodes, avoid high-risk P1 packets, and carry appropriate caveats.
